Players Committee card image of [[I've Got A Really Good Feeling About This]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If you have two smugglers on table, choose one: If opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw one card from Reserve Deck (two if [Set 13] Han on table). OR If there are more [Dark Side] than [Light Side] on table, activate 1 Force (2 if [Set 13] Han on table). OR Re-circulate.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/I%27ve%20Got%20A%20Really%20Good%20Feeling%20About%20This.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/I've Got A Really Good Feeling About This.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
